channel.title: Release Radar — sqlalchemy (pypi)
channel.description: Releases of sqlalchemy (pypi) (newest first, up to 50, incl. earlier history); flagged ones carry a verbatim quote. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.

item.title: sqlalchemy 2.1.9
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: These objects now apply to the `Column` only, and are no longer used as the Python-side default value of the attribute, which now remains `None` until the object is flushed. Quote: On the 2.1 series, where `_sql.Select.params()` no longer copies the statement, the issue still applies to `visitors.cloned_traverse()` and similar traversals. Release notes: https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/releases/tag/rel_2_1_9
